niches.cpm_note: High CPM ($8–15) — history advertisers pay well and retention is strong.
example_video_ideas: The Most Disturbing Punishments in Medieval History
What Really Happened on the Night the Titanic's Band Kept Playing
The Village That Vanished Overnight — History's Creepiest Mystery
niches.name: Scary History
niches.why_it_works: Dark historical events trigger curiosity and morbid fascination; narration-over-stock-footage is cheap to produce and endlessly renewable.

niches.cpm_note: High CPM ($10–18) — science/tech advertisers bid aggressively.
example_video_ideas: What's Actually Inside a Black Hole — The Latest Science
The Signal From Deep Space That Scientists Can't Explain
Why We'll Never Leave the Solar System
niches.name: Space Documentaries
niches.why_it_works: Cosmic-scale visuals are free (NASA/ESA public domain) and the audience skews educated with long watch times.

niches.cpm_note: Medium CPM ($5–9) — huge audience but heavy advertiser filtering on graphic topics.
example_video_ideas: The Heist That Took 4 Minutes and $5 Million
She Solved Her Own Murder — The Case of the Diary
The Con Artist Who Fooled an Entire Country
niches.name: True Crime
niches.why_it_works: Massive evergreen demand; storytelling skill beats production budget. Keep it advertiser-friendly by avoiding gore.

niches.cpm_note: Very high CPM ($15–30) — finance is YouTube's most lucrative ad category.
example_video_ideas: How the 2008 Crash Actually Worked — Explained Simply
Why Everything Feels Expensive Now (It's Not Just Inflation)
The $2 Trillion Company Nobody Understands
niches.name: Financial Explainers
niches.why_it_works: Money curiosity is universal; simple motion-graphics explainers outperform talking heads for retention.

niches.cpm_note: Medium CPM ($6–10) — broad male 18–44 demographic advertisers like.
example_video_ideas: The Game That Broke a 108-Year Curse
How One Decision Ruined the Greatest Team Ever Built
The Unknown Athlete Who Humiliated the Champions
niches.name: Sports Stories
niches.why_it_works: Drama, underdogs, and rivalries write themselves; fair-use commentary over archival clips is a proven format.

example_video_ideas: The Animal That Cannot Feel Pain — And What It Teaches Us
Why Orcas Are Hunting Something New
The Tiny Creature That Survives Being Frozen Solid
niches.name: Animal Documentaries
niches.why_it_works: Nature footage is abundant and royalty-free; animal behavior stories get shared heavily and rewatch well.

niches.cpm_note: Low–medium CPM ($3–6) — cheap to make, monetized on volume.
example_video_ideas: Reddit's Most Unhinged Neighbor Stories
Am I the Villain? — The Internet Decides
People Who Found Out Their Whole Life Was a Lie
niches.name: Reddit Stories
niches.why_it_works: Infinite free source material (r/AskReddit, AITA); TTS + gameplay background is the lowest-effort format that still scales.

niches.cpm_note: High CPM ($10–20) — luxury brands pay premium rates.
example_video_ideas: Inside the $250 Million Yacht Nobody Can Buy
Why Billionaires Are Building Bunkers in New Zealand
The Most Expensive Mistake in Watchmaking History
niches.name: Luxury Documentaries
niches.why_it_works: Aspiration content gets high CTR; viewers binge 'how the rich live' marathons, boosting session time.

niches.cpm_note: Medium–high CPM ($7–12) — educated audience, strong retention.
example_video_ideas: The Map That Shouldn't Exist — The Piri Reis Mystery
What the Pyramids Looked Like Before They Were Ruins
The Ancient Computer Found in a Shipwreck
niches.name: Ancient Mysteries
niches.why_it_works: Unsolved puzzles from antiquity create irresistible curiosity gaps; new discoveries give you fresh angles weekly.

niches.cpm_note: High CPM ($12–20) — tech advertisers flood this category.
example_video_ideas: The AI Model That Passed the Bar Exam — What It Means for Jobs
5 AI Tools That Just Changed Video Editing Forever
Why Every Tech CEO Is Suddenly Scared of AI
niches.name: AI News
niches.why_it_works: The news cycle writes your scripts; speed beats polish. Early coverage of each breakthrough compounds into authority.

niches.cpm_note: Low CPM ($3–5) — huge views, cheap ads; monetize via digital products.
example_video_ideas: The Speech That Saved a Man From Giving Up
Why Discipline Beats Motivation — The Science
What 100 Rejections Taught One Founder
niches.name: Motivational
niches.why_it_works: Emotion-driven sharing; cinematic stock + powerful voiceover is a solved formula. Differentiate with original writing.

example_video_ideas: Why This Country Has Borders Inside Borders
The River That Flows Backwards Twice a Year
The Town Split Between Two Countries
niches.name: Geography
niches.why_it_works: Map animations are cheap and mesmerizing; 'why borders look weird' style videos have extreme binge potential.

niches.cpm_note: Medium CPM ($6–11) — strong male demographic, defense-adjacent advertisers.
example_video_ideas: The Submarine That Vanished With 129 Men Aboard
How One Pilot Outflew an Entire Squadron
The Weapon Too Dangerous to Ever Use Again
niches.name: Military
niches.why_it_works: Declassified stories and hardware deep-dives attract a loyal, high-retention audience that's underserved.

niches.cpm_note: Medium CPM ($5–9) — mystery audiences watch to the very end.
example_video_ideas: The Flight That Landed 37 Years Late — Fact or Legend?
The Man Who Appeared From Nowhere at Tokyo Airport
The Numbers Station Still Broadcasting Today
niches.name: Unsolved Mysteries
niches.why_it_works: Open loops keep viewers watching; each video spawns comment theories that boost engagement metrics.

niches.cpm_note: Medium CPM ($5–8) — self-improvement advertisers convert well.
example_video_ideas: Why Your Brain Lies to You Every Morning
The 3-Second Trick That Makes People Trust You
What Your Sleeping Position Reveals About You
niches.name: Psychology Facts
niches.why_it_works: Self-relevant content ('why YOU do this') drives clicks; short fact formats are perfect for Shorts-to-long funnels.

niches.cpm_note: High CPM ($10–16) — SaaS and gadget advertisers pay well.
example_video_ideas: How Your Phone Knows Where You Are — Even With GPS Off
Why Charging to 100% Is Slowly Killing Your Battery
The Tiny Chip Shortage That Stopped Car Factories
niches.name: Tech Explainers
niches.why_it_works: Everyone uses tech, few understand it; clean visual explainers get embedded in blogs and classrooms for passive views.

niches.cpm_note: Medium–high CPM ($7–12) — speculative science attracts curious, educated viewers.
example_video_ideas: What If Gravity Turned Off for 5 Seconds
What If Humans Could Photosynthesize
What If the Internet Shut Down for a Week
niches.name: What-If Scenarios
niches.why_it_works: Hypothetical scenarios ('what if the moon disappeared') are irresistible clickbait that actually delivers.

niches.cpm_note: Medium CPM ($6–10) — documentary-style retention is excellent.
example_video_ideas: The 4 Minutes That Doomed Flight 447
How a Single Bolt Brought Down a Jumbo Jet
The Miracle Landing With No Engines
niches.name: Aviation Disasters
niches.why_it_works: Investigation-format storytelling with a loyal niche audience; accuracy and respect set the winners apart.
